name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
summary: A seated overhead press with dumbbells that trains the shoulders and triceps with back support for stability.
setup: Set the bench back to a near-upright angle and sit with back and glutes against the pad.
Lift the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms forward or slightly angled.
Plant feet firmly and brace the abs.
Keep forearms near vertical under the dumbbells.
execution: Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are nearly straight.
Let them come slightly toward each other at the top without clanking.
Lower under control until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
mistakes: Back arching off the pad: keep the lower back supported and lower the weight.
Elbows flared far behind the body: keep them slightly in front of the shoulders.
Shrugging up: keep the shoulders down until the arms extend.
Partial range of motion: lower to about ear level.

references.title: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press Technique and Spotting Tutorial
references.author: Josh Hauptman
